tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the Plate Artists recipe catalog by words in the dish name or keywords, cuisine, category, vegetarian, and total time. Returns short cards with ids and URLs; call get_recipe for the full recipe. Call list_recipe_filters for the exact cuisine and category values.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: The full recipe by id: description, times, servings, ingredients with quantities, the method step by step, plating ideas (how to plate and garnish it), food-safety notes, FAQ and the page URL.

tools.name: random_recipe
tools.description: One random full recipe, optionally limited by cuisine, category or vegetarian. For "what should I cook tonight?" questions.

tools.name: list_recipe_filters
tools.description: The cuisines and categories in the recipe catalog, to use as exact filter values.

tools.name: find_guide
tools.description: Find Plate Artists guides, board guides, holiday hubs and free tools on a topic: plating technique, garnishes, sauces, plate types, knife skills, table setting, napkin folding, food photography, charcuterie boards and more. Returns titles, summaries and URLs. Without a query, lists every guide.

tools.name: charcuterie_board_calculator
tools.description: How much cheese, cured meat, crackers, fruit, nuts and jars to buy for a charcuterie board, and what size board, for a guest count.

tools.name: party_food_calculator
tools.description: How much food and drink to buy for a party: appetizer pieces, then the mains, sides, salads, bread and desserts you pick, and drinks for the hours.

tools.name: turkey_calculator
tools.description: What size turkey to buy for a guest count, USDA roasting time at 325°F, fridge and cold-water thawing time, and the done temperature.

tools.name: ham_calculator
tools.description: How much ham to buy per person and USDA FSIS cooking or reheating time and safe temperature. label: cooked = fully cooked (reheat); cbe = cook before eating; fresh = raw pork leg; country = dry-cured country ham. Not every label has every cut.

tools.name: prime_rib_calculator
tools.description: How big a prime rib (standing rib roast) to buy for a guest count, roasting time, the pull temperature for the doneness you want, and the rest. Classic 350°F roast or reverse sear.

tools.name: thanksgiving_timeline
tools.description: A Thanksgiving cooking schedule worked back from the dinner time: what to do on each day before (thawing, make-ahead dishes), when the turkey goes in and comes out, which oven each side dish goes in and when, and any dish that does not fit the ovens, with fixes. tools.name: knife_cut_size
tools.description: The size and method of a classic knife cut (julienne, brunoise, batonnet, small dice, chiffonade, paysanne, tourné, mirepoix and more), in inches and millimetres. Without a cut, lists every cut with its size.

tools.name: plate_color_pairing
tools.description: Which plate colour flatters a dish and which makes it disappear, by the food's dominant colour; or which foods a plate you own suits. Call with neither to see the colour families and plates.
